clauses.clause: This creature attacks each combat if able.
Ferocious — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, you may pay {R}.
If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

mapping.notes: Rubblebelt Recluse's verified MANDATE_ATTACK; Ferocious: beginning of combat on your turn, Furious Rise's 'if you control a creature with power 4 or greater' as the condition, Ghostly Pilferer's may-pay {R} and Silversmote Ghoul's 'return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield' (works from the graveyard only, CR 113.6m). Flying, haste compiled. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: flamewake_phoenix_ferocious_returns_it_and_it_attacks, flamewake_phoenix_no_ferocious_stays_in_the_graveyard, flamewake_phoenix_declined_or_opponents_turn_stays. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.
